title: Step 4: Make User Input a Valid String

blocks.content: Step 4: Make User Input a Valid String

items: changed the getUserPick() method to take valid input

blocks.content: We have created an infinite while loop inside this method. Inside the loop, we have asked for user input.

If this value is either "rock" or "paper" or "scissors", the break statement terminates the loop. However, if the user input is invalid, the loop is again iterated and the user is again asked for the input.
